rootCause: Authenticated order WebSocket reused cached ID token without asking SessionService to refresh the access/ID pair. Reopening app could replay expired identity scope.
fix: Await existing SessionService.getToken before reading current subject and ID token. Failed refresh never falls back to an authenticated guest connection. Existing server ownership/expiry fences unchanged.

verification.runtime: After new build and reopening tracking, first four simulated movement events acknowledged by one current authorized customer connection.

scope: No server changes, no financial writes or saved GPS mutations
limitations: Regression tests cover identity/model/map; actual refresh proven by renewed runtime connection and delivered events, not a new isolated refresh-service test.
